prompt:
A desktop landing page for LeadAIO, rendered edge to edge at 1536x1024 with crisp readable text, no browser window, device or desk.

LeadAIO is a managed AI visibility agency for B2B SaaS marketing teams. It gets brands named and cited when buyers ask ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini and Google AI Overviews which tool to buy, by placing them in the Reddit threads, review sites and best-of lists those engines read. The visitor is a head of marketing who should book a strategy call.

This comp is console-led and goes further than a normal landing page: the whole first screen is one mission-control wall seen straight on, and the page's parts live in its panels. Reading order: a thin top bar with the LeadAIO wordmark, links The mission, Programs, Telemetry, FAQ, and a gold "Book a call" button. The largest panel holds the headline "Your brand, named first in AI answers." with one supporting sentence and a gold "Book a strategy call" button. Around it, smaller working panels: a live answer feed showing a buyer prompt "best payroll software for startups" with the brand named first and its sources (a Reddit thread, a G2 page, a best-of list); a source-routing panel; and a status panel "Named in 16 of 40 prompts" with per-engine values ChatGPT 42%, Perplexity 47%, Gemini 29%, AI Overviews 34%, tagged "Example data".

Look: deep black ground with thin dark-gold panel rules; gold is reserved for live values, the brand's name in answers and the action; warm off-white text. A wide, technical grotesk for headlines and a monospace face only for numbers. Precise like a real operations room, not a sci-fi poster: no planets, stars, holograms or glow.
